name: agent-plugin-kit
description: Dependency-free contracts and maintenance tooling for Agent Plugin repositories.

scripts.check: git diff --check && bun -e 'import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs"; const required=["README.md","AGENTS.md","CONTEXT.md","CONTEXT-MAP.md","CODING_STANDARDS.md","package.json","docs/agents/README.md","docs/agents/issue-tracker.md","docs/agents/domain.md","docs/agents/triage-labels.md","docs/adr/0001-language-to-topology.md"]; const forbidden=["src","clean-fixture",".github/workflows"]; for (const path of required) if (!existsSync(path)) throw new Error(`missing ${path}`); for (const path of forbidden) if (existsSync(path)) throw new Error(`premature ${path}`); const agents=readFileSync("AGENTS.md","utf8"); for (const path of ["CONTEXT.md","CONTEXT-MAP.md","CODING_STANDARDS.md","docs/agents/README.md","docs/agents/issue-tracker.md","docs/agents/domain.md","docs/agents/triage-labels.md"]) if (!agents.includes(path)) throw new Error(`missing AGENTS pointer ${path}`);'
